item.title: Photos: Lindsey Vonn crashes in Olympic downhill
item.description: Lindsey Vonn, racing on a badly injured left knee, crashed early in the Olympic downhill on Sunday and was taken off the course by a helicopter after the 41-year-old American received medical attention on the snow for long, anguished minutes.

item.title: Super Bowl 60: Seahawks take second Super Bowl title, beating Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks bested the New England Patriots on Sunday at Super Bowl LX in a lopsided game with a historic defensive performance.

item.title: Thousands celebrate at Goldens in Golden festival
